text: 1. Non-chinese nationals holding valid passports or nationality certificates.2. Aged 18 to 25, with a high school diploma or above.3. Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit to China.4. Be friendly to China, diligent and eager to learn, have good academic performance, upright conduct, abide by laws and regulations, have no record of violating school rules and regulations, and have no criminal record.5. Language proficiency requirements: Applicants whose native language is English are exempt from providing proof of English language proficiency. Applicants whose native language is not English must have proof of IELTS Academic test scores (not lower than 6.0, with no individual score lower than 5.0), TOEFL (Internet based test not lower than 70, with no individual score lower than 15), or other equivalent English test scores (70 (inclusive) or above on a 100-point scale). Applicants whose native language is not English and whose highest academic qualification was taught in English do not need to provide IELTS/TOEFL scores, but they must submit proof of the language of instruction.
